title: All PWAs Vanish Upon Phone Reboots
summary: **Vanadium Version:** 153.0.8010.36.0 (Beta Branch) **Vanadium Config Version:** 207 **Graphene OS Version:** Android 17; Pixel 8 Build/CP2A.260805.005 ---- ### Summary: Rebooting the device for any reason causes existing PWAs to vanish from the home launcher. I have a lot of PWAs, so having to reinstall all of them every time I do an OS update is tedious so I'd be glad if whatever caused this in Vanadium can be found and fixed. Several versions of Vanadium have come out already since this started a while ago, so I don't know the exact version that started this but I tried to tolerate it thinking maybe it will just get patched later... but it never did. So, I'm finally taking the moment to post this. ### What was expected: All PWAs to persist across reboots like they used to ### What happens: All PWAs get uninstalled after every phone reboot
